- [**PostGIS**](https://postgis.net): extension of PostgreSQL to turn it into a functional geospatial database.
- [**GeoPandas**](https://geopandas.org/en/stable/): Python library for geospatial data processing
- [**JupyterGIS**](https://github.com/geojupyter/jupytergis): web-based app for real-time collaborative GIS work, QGIS and Python integration
